title: 第25章 盾构机成精了第26章 接管指挥权
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: “卧槽！”
林默差点从树杈上栽下去。
他死死盯着那玩意儿，脑子里只有一个念头。
“这他妈不是盾构机成精了吗？！”
这玩意儿一出来，还守个屁的防线。
人家直接不走大门，从你家地底下钻出来，给你来个中心开花！
“攻击那头怪物！快！”
芬朵娜大声呐喊，月华法杖顶端光芒大盛，一条水龙卷咆哮着砸向地蟒。
所有精灵法师都反应过来，冰锥、火球、风刃，不要钱一样往地蟒身上招呼。
地面上，精灵战士射出最后一箭，拔出双剑冲了上去，却被数不清的低阶魔物死死缠住。
他们只能眼睁睁看着那头巨蟒，顶着魔法轰炸，一寸寸地拱出地面。
“阻止它！一定要阻止它出来！”
芬朵娜的声音里带着绝望。
一旦这头战争巨兽完全出来，它那张嘴能把整个营地搅个天翻地覆！
地蟒巨大的体型带来了恐怖的魔法抗性。
几百道魔法轰在它身上，也就是让它表皮抽搐了几下，根本不破防。
在剧烈的翻滚中，它庞大的身躯终于彻底挣脱了地道的束缚！
又一轮魔法集火终于轰开了它的皮肉，巨兽的身躯猛地一僵，血肉横飞地摔在地上。
巨响声中，尘土飞扬。
虽然地蟒快死了，但它的任务已经完成。
那个黑漆漆、冒着硫磺臭气的洞口里，传出金属摩擦的怪声和令人头皮发麻的嘶吼。
无穷无尽的魔族生物，眼中闪烁着红光，像腐烂的洪水一样涌了出来！
打头的是一排举着巨大骨盾的重甲魔兵。
身高超过三米五，浑身肌肉虬结，皮肤是肮脏的灰绿色。
它们手里的骨盾厚得像一堵墙，上面还闪着不祥的暗红色魔纹，一看就是血厚防高的“坦克”。
在它们身后，一道暗色的透明护罩悄然升起，把整个洞口和周围百米都罩了进去。
精灵法师们的后续魔法砸在上面，只激起一阵阵涟漪，然后就没了动静。
“放箭！”
一名精灵百夫长大吼。
“嗖嗖嗖！”
无数传统长弓射出的箭矢飞过去，叮叮当当地砸在骨盾上，除了溅起几点火星，连刮痧都算不上。
那几个重甲魔兵甚至挑衅地用盾牌拍着胸口，发出“咚咚”的闷响。
content_en:
"Fuck!"
Lin Mo almost fell off the tree branch.
He stared at the thing with only one thought in his mind.
"Isn't this a fucking shield machine that's perfect?!"
As soon as this thing came out, it still had a shitty defense.
They don't just go through the front door, they come out from under your house and give you a center to bloom!
"Attack that monster! Quick!"
Fendona shouted loudly, the top of the Moonlight Staff glowed brightly, and a waterspout roared and hit the ground python.
All the elven mages reacted and threw ice cones, fireballs, and wind blades at the ground python as if they were free of charge.
On the ground, the elf warrior shot the last arrow, drew his swords and rushed forward, but was tightly entangled by countless low-level monsters.
They could only watch helplessly as the giant python, withstanding the magic bombardment, rose out of the ground inch by inch.
"Stop it! We must stop it from coming out!"
Fendona's voice was filled with despair.
Once this giant war beast comes out completely, its mouth can turn the entire camp upside down!
The huge size of the ground python brings terrifying magic resistance.
Hundreds of magic blasts hit it, causing its skin to twitch a few times without breaking its defense at all.
In the violent rolling, its huge body finally broke free from the shackles of the tunnel!
Another round of magic fire finally blasted away its skin and flesh. The giant beast's body suddenly stiffened, and its flesh and blood fell to the ground.
"Boom!!"
Amidst the loud noise, dust flew up.
Although the ground python is dying, its mission is accomplished.
From the dark, sulfur-smelling hole came the strange sound of metal friction and a scalp-numbing roar.
Endless demon creatures, with red light flashing in their eyes, poured out like a rotten flood!
At the head was a row of heavily armored demon soldiers holding huge bone shields.
He is over three and a half meters tall, with muscles all over his body and dirty gray-green skin.
The bone shields in their hands are as thick as a wall, and there are ominous dark red magic patterns shining on them. At first glance, they are "tanks" with thick health and high defense.
Behind them, a dark transparent shield rose quietly, covering the entire cave entrance and the surrounding hundred meters.
The follow-up magic from the elf mages hit it, only causing ripples, and then there was no movement.
"Fire the arrow!"
an elf centurion yelled.
"Swish swish!"
Countless arrows shot from traditional longbows flew over and hit the bone shield with a clanging sound. Apart from splashing a few sparks, it was not even a scratch.
Those heavily armored demon soldiers even slapped their chests with their shields provocatively, making a muffled sound of "dong dong".
